integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic macro and wide cinematography, photorealistic, one continuous unbroken ten-second shot. The camera drifts through a fjord between sheer granite walls, a thread of waterfall falling into dark water, then slowly lowers toward a tiny detail in it: a sunlit pinhole in a green leaf. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed. It pushes closer and closer until the detail fills the frame completely and the camera passes into it. The shot ends as the camera dives into a sunlit pinhole in a green leaf.

overall_soundscape: Distant falling water echoing off the cliffs and the sound narrowing to a hush as the camera closes in.
